accept.example: The supplier accepted our offer to extend the deadline.
accept.example_translation: 供应商接受了我们延长截止时间的提议。
accept.usage: accept an offer / apology，表示接纳提议或接受道歉。

access.example: Only managers have access to these records.
access.example_translation: 只有经理有权查阅这些记录。
access.usage: have access to files，表示有权访问文件。

access.example: The west entrance provides access to the building.
access.example_translation: 从西门可以进入这栋大楼。
access.usage: access to the building，指进入大楼的通道。

access.example: Employees can access the database from the office.
access.example_translation: 员工可以在办公室访问数据库。
access.usage: access a database，表示访问数据库。

access.example: You can access the meeting room with your key card.
access.example_translation: 你可以用门卡进入会议室。
access.usage: access a room using a key card，表示用门卡进入某处。

accommodate.example: The main hall can accommodate up to 250 guests.
accommodate.example_translation: 主厅最多可容纳 250 位宾客。
accommodate.usage: accommodate + 人数，表示空间足够容纳这么多人。

accommodation.example: We will arrange accommodation for the visiting trainers.
accommodation.example_translation: 我们会为来访的培训师安排住宿。
accommodation.usage: arrange accommodation for + 人，指为某人安排住宿。

accommodation.example: The conference fee includes accommodation and breakfast.
accommodation.example_translation: 会议费用包含住宿和早餐。
accommodation.usage: accommodation 在差旅语境中通常指住宿，套餐是否含餐由上下文说明。

accounting.example: The accounting department checks each invoice before paying it.
accounting.example_translation: 会计部门在付款前核查每张发票。
accounting.usage: the accounting department 指负责记账和会计业务的部门。

additional.example: Please contact reception if you need additional information.
additional.example_translation: 如需更多信息，请联系接待处。
additional.spelling_prompt: 附加的、额外的，例如随通知提供的补充信息
additional.usage: additional + 名词，常与 information、cost、staff 搭配。

additional.example: Please contact reception if you need additional information.
additional.example_translation: 如需更多信息，请联系接待处。
additional.spelling_prompt: 附加的、额外的，例如随通知提供的补充信息
additional.usage: additional + 名词，常与 information、cost、staff 搭配。

advantage.example: The earlier launch gave us an advantage over our competitors.
advantage.example_translation: 较早推出产品让我们相对竞争对手更有优势。
advantage.usage: an advantage over a competitor，表示相对竞争对手的优势。

advantage.example: One advantage of booking online is that you can compare prices.
advantage.example_translation: 在线预订的一个优点是可以比较价格。
advantage.usage: one advantage of doing something，指做某事的一个优点。

advantage.example: The main advantage of this route is its shorter travel time.
advantage.example_translation: 这条路线的主要好处是用时更短。
advantage.usage: the main advantage of something，指某事物的主要好处。

advise.example: The technician advised us to replace the battery.
advise.example_translation: 技术员建议我们更换电池。
advise.usage: advise someone to do something，表示建议某人做某事。

anniversary.example: The museum will mark its fiftieth anniversary in April.
anniversary.example_translation: 博物馆将在四月迎来五十周年纪念。
anniversary.spelling_prompt: 周年纪念日，指某一事件发生后每年的纪念日期
anniversary.usage: mark / celebrate an anniversary，表示纪念或庆祝周年。

announce.example: The board will announce its decision on Monday.
announce.example_translation: 董事会将在星期一公布决定。
announce.usage: announce a decision，表示公开宣布决定。

announcement.example: The airline made an announcement about the gate change.
announcement.example_translation: 航空公司广播了登机口变更的通知。
announcement.usage: make an announcement about + 事项，表示公开宣布该事项。

annual.example: We publish our annual report in March.
annual.usage: annual report / meeting，表示每年发布的报告或每年举行的会议。

annual.example: The board approved the annual budget on Tuesday.
annual.example_translation: 董事会周二批准了年度预算。
annual.usage: annual budget，指覆盖一个财政年度的预算。

apologize.example: She apologized to the client for the late delivery.
apologize.example_translation: 她因送货迟到向客户道歉。
apologize.usage: apologize to someone for + 原因，表示就某事向某人道歉。

apology.example: The hotel offered an apology for the booking error.
apology.spelling_prompt: 道歉，常和正式表达歉意的 offer 或 accept 搭配
apology.usage: offer an apology for + 原因，表示为某事道歉。

applicant.example: Each applicant for the position must provide two references.
applicant.example_translation: 每位应聘该职位的人都必须提供两份推荐证明。
applicant.spelling_prompt: 申请者，指已提交职位、资格或入会申请的人
applicant.usage: an applicant for + 职位或资格，表示该职位或资格的申请者。

application.example: Please fill out an application before you visit.
application.example_translation: 请在来访前填写申请表。
application.usage: fill out an application，表示填写申请表。

application.example: She submitted her application for the position yesterday.
application.example_translation: 她昨天提交了该职位的申请。
application.usage: submit an application for a position，表示提交职位申请。

application.example: The course covers the practical application of these techniques.
application.example_translation: 课程介绍了这些技术的实际应用。
application.usage: the practical application of an idea，指一个想法的实际应用。

apply for.example: You can apply for the position online.
apply for.example_translation: 你可以在线申请这个职位。
apply for.usage: apply for + 职位、贷款或许可，表示提出申请。

appoint.example: The board appointed Ms. Lopez as finance director.
appoint.example_translation: 董事会任命洛佩斯女士担任财务总监。
appoint.usage: appoint someone as + 职位，表示任命某人担任该职位。

appointment.example: The company announced the appointment of a new director.
appointment.example_translation: 公司宣布任命了一名新总监。
appointment.usage: announce an appointment，表示公布人事任命。

appointment.example: Please make an appointment with the adviser before coming in.
appointment.example_translation: 来访前请先和顾问预约。
appointment.usage: make an appointment with someone，表示与某人约好见面的时间。

appreciate.example: We appreciate your taking the time to review our proposal.
appreciate.example_translation: 感谢您抽时间审阅我们的提案。
appreciate.usage: appreciate + 名词或动名词，表示感谢他人帮忙。

appreciate.example: We appreciate your patience while the new system is installed.
appreciate.example_translation: 安装新系统期间，感谢您的耐心等候。
appreciate.usage: appreciate your patience，常用于感谢对方耐心等候。

appreciation.example: We held a dinner to show appreciation for the volunteers' work.
appreciation.example_translation: 我们举办晚宴以感谢志愿者的工作。
appreciation.usage: show appreciation for something，表示对某事表达感谢。

appreciation.example: The manager showed appreciation for her team's creativity.
appreciation.example_translation: 经理对团队的创造力表示认可。
appreciation.usage: show appreciation for someone's skills，表示认可或赏识某人的能力。

approach.example: We need a new approach to training part-time staff.
approach.example_translation: 我们需要用新的方法培训兼职员工。
approach.usage: an approach to + 名词或动名词，表示处理某事的方法。

approximate.example: Please include an approximate delivery date in the quote.
approximate.example_translation: 请在报价中注明大致交货日期。
approximate.usage: an approximate cost / time，表示估算的费用或时间。

aspect.example: Cost is only one aspect of the decision.
aspect.example_translation: 成本只是作这项决定时要考虑的一个方面。
aspect.usage: one aspect of + 事物，表示其中的一个方面。

assign.example: The supervisor assigned the inventory check to Rosa.
assign.example_translation: 主管把盘点任务分配给了罗莎。
assign.usage: assign a task to someone，表示将任务分配给某人。

assistance.example: Our staff can provide assistance with the registration form.
assistance.example_translation: 我们的工作人员可以协助您填写报名表。
assistance.usage: provide assistance with + 事项，表示就某事提供帮助。

assure.example: I assured the customer that the order would arrive on time.
assure.example_translation: 我向顾客保证订单会准时送达。
assure.usage: assure someone that + 从句，表示向某人保证某事。

assure.example: The representative assured us of continued support.
assure.example_translation: 这位代表向我们保证会继续提供支持。
assure.usage: assure someone of something，表示使某人相信或对某事放心。

attach.example: Please attach the signed form to your email.
attach.example_translation: 请在电子邮件中附上签好的表格。
attach.usage: attach something to an email / form，表示把文件附在邮件或表格上。

attachment.example: Please review the attachment before tomorrow’s meeting.
attachment.example_translation: 请在明天开会前查阅附件。
attachment.usage: open / download an attachment，表示打开或下载邮件附件。

attend.example: Please let us know whether you can attend the orientation.
attend.example_translation: 请告知您能否参加入职介绍会。
attend.usage: attend a meeting / conference，直接接活动名称。

attendee.example: Every conference attendee received a schedule at the entrance.
attendee.example_translation: 每位与会者都在入口处领到一份日程表。
attendee.spelling_prompt: 出席者，指到会议或活动现场报到的人
attendee.usage: conference attendee，指到场参加会议的人。

available.example: Are you available for a call at two?
available.usage: be available at a specific time，表示某个时间有空。

available.example: The updated schedule is available online.
available.example_translation: 更新后的时间表可以在网上查看。
available.usage: be available online，表示可以在网上获得或使用。

benefit.example: New employees will benefit from the training.
benefit.example_translation: 新员工将从这项培训中受益。
benefit.usage: benefit from training，表示从培训中获益。

benefit.example: The new train service will benefit local businesses.
benefit.example_translation: 新增的列车服务将使当地企业受益。
benefit.usage: benefit local businesses，表示使当地企业受益。

benefit.example: Health insurance is one of our employee benefits.
benefit.example_translation: 健康保险是我们的员工福利之一。
benefit.usage: employee benefits，指员工享有的福利。

benefit.example: The main benefit of online booking is convenience.
benefit.example_translation: 在线预订的主要好处是方便。
benefit.usage: the main benefit of doing something，指做某件事的主要好处。

benefit.example: The survey explains the benefits of a flexible schedule.
benefit.example_translation: 这项调查说明了灵活排班的好处。
benefit.usage: the benefits of a flexible schedule，指灵活安排的好处。

brochure.example: The visitor center has a brochure about local walking tours.
brochure.example_translation: 游客中心备有介绍当地徒步游览项目的小册子。
brochure.usage: a brochure about + 主题，常指介绍服务或景点的小册子。

budget.example: We need to budget for equipment repairs next year.
budget.example_translation: 我们需要为明年的设备维修预留预算。
budget.usage: budget for + 支出项目，表示为该项目预留预算。

budget.example: The renovation was completed within budget.
budget.example_translation: 翻修工程完工了，开支在预算之内。
budget.usage: within budget 表示开支处于预算额度内。

cancelation.example: The hotel charges a cancelation fee for late changes.
cancelation.example_translation: 临近入住日期才更改预订，酒店会收取取消费用。
cancelation.usage: a cancelation fee，表示取消预订可能产生的费用。

cause.example: The team is investigating the cause of the delay.
cause.example_translation: 团队正在调查延误的原因。
cause.usage: the cause of a delay，指造成延误的原因。

cause.example: Our staff volunteered to support a local cause.
cause.example_translation: 员工自愿支持当地一项公益事业。
cause.usage: support a cause，表示支持一项事业或公益目标。

cause.example: A broken conveyor belt caused a delay in production.
cause.example_translation: 传送带故障导致生产延误。
cause.usage: cause a delay，表示造成延误。

charge.example: The hotel does not charge guests for parking.
charge.example_translation: 酒店不向住客收取停车费。
charge.usage: charge someone for a service，表示向某人收取服务费。

charge.example: The courier charges a fee for same-day delivery.
charge.example_translation: 这家快递公司对当日送达服务收费。
charge.usage: charge a fee for a service，表示对服务收费。

charge.example: A service charge is included in the bill.
We only charge for delivery outside the city.
charge.example_translation: 我们只针对市外配送收取送货费。
charge.usage: charge for delivery，表示收取送货费。

colleague.example: I worked with a colleague from the finance department.
colleague.example_translation: 我和财务部的一位同事一起工作。
colleague.usage: a colleague from another department，指来自另一个部门的同事。

commence.example: The hearing will commence at nine o’clock.
commence.usage: commence at + 时间，表示会议等在某时开始，语气正式。

commitment.example: The company made a commitment to improve workplace safety.
commitment.example_translation: 公司承诺改善工作场所的安全状况。
commitment.usage: make a commitment to do something，表示承诺做某事。

commitment.example: Her commitment to training helped new employees settle in.
commitment.example_translation: 她在培训工作上的投入帮助新员工适应了环境。
commitment.usage: commitment to + 工作或目标，表示为此持续投入。

commuter.example: The earlier train is popular with commuters.
commuter.example_translation: 较早的一班火车很受通勤者欢迎。
commuter.spelling_prompt: 通勤者，指经常往返住处和工作地点的人
commuter.usage: a daily commuter，指日常往返住处与工作地点的人。

competition.example: Six teams entered the regional design competition.
competition.example_translation: 有六支队伍报名参加地区设计比赛。
competition.usage: enter a competition，表示报名参加比赛。

complaint.example: A customer filed a complaint about the delayed delivery.
complaint.example_translation: 一位客户就迟迟未送达的货物提出了投诉。
complaint.spelling_prompt: 投诉，指客户因服务或商品问题提出的正式不满
complaint.usage: file a complaint about + 事项，表示就某事提出正式投诉。

concern.example: Several residents expressed concern about the noise.
concern.example_translation: 几位居民对噪声表示担忧。
concern.usage: express concern about + 事情，表示就该事情表达担忧。

confirm.example: Could you confirm our booking before we send the deposit?
confirm.example_translation: 您能在我们支付订金前确认预订吗？
confirm.usage: confirm a booking / reservation，表示正式确认预订。

confirm.example: We will confirm the meeting date this afternoon.
confirm.example_translation: 我们今天下午会确定会议日期。
confirm.usage: confirm an appointment or a date，表示确认或确定约定的时间。

congratulate.example: We congratulated Leah on her promotion.
congratulate.spelling_prompt: 向获得晋升、奖项或其他成就的人表示祝贺
congratulate.usage: congratulate someone on + 成就，表示因某项成就而祝贺某人。

consider.example: We are considering extending the store’s opening hours.
consider.example_translation: 我们正在考虑延长门店的营业时间。
consider.usage: consider doing something，表示认真考虑采取某项行动。

construction.example: The new terminal is still under construction.
construction.spelling_prompt: 建设、施工，指建造建筑物或设施的过程
construction.usage: under construction，表示建筑物或设施正在施工。

contact.example: Please contact the warehouse manager about the missing shipment.
contact.example_translation: 有关未收到的货物，请联系仓库经理。
contact.usage: contact + 人或部门，用于表示直接联系某人。

contract.example: We signed a two-year contract with the cleaning company.
contract.example_translation: 我们与保洁公司签订了为期两年的合同。
contract.usage: sign a contract with + 对方，表示和对方签订合同。

contribution.example: The director thanked Janet for her contribution to the project.
contribution.example_translation: 总监感谢珍妮特为项目作出的贡献。
contribution.usage: make a contribution to + 项目或组织，表示对该工作有所贡献。

convince.example: The pilot program convinced the team to adopt the new system.
convince.example_translation: 试点项目促使团队接受了采用新系统的建议。
convince.usage: convince someone to do something，表示说服某人采取行动。

cooperation.example: The project required cooperation between two departments.
cooperation.example_translation: 该项目需要两个部门合作。
cooperation.usage: cooperation between + 各方，表示多方共同开展工作。

cost.example: We calculated the cost of replacing the old equipment.
cost.example_translation: 我们算出了更换旧设备的成本。
cost.usage: the cost of + 名词或动名词，表示购买或进行某事的成本。

current.example: Please send me a copy of the current price list.
current.example_translation: 请把目前的价目表发我一份。
current.usage: current + 名词，表示目前的状态或计划。

currently.example: The team is currently reviewing the contract.
currently.example_translation: 团队目前正在审查合同。
currently.usage: currently + 动词，表示眼下正在进行的事情。

currently.example: Two meeting rooms are currently available.
currently.example_translation: 目前有两间会议室可用。
currently.usage: be currently available，表示当前可用。

damage.example: Improper storage can damage the equipment.
damage.example_translation: 存放不当可能损坏设备。
damage.usage: damage equipment / property，表示损坏设备或财物。

delay.example: A delay in shipping forced us to revise the delivery schedule.
delay.example_translation: 发货延误迫使我们调整了交付时间表。
delay.usage: a delay in + 名词或动名词，表示某件事出现延迟。

delivery.example: The supplier confirmed the delivery date this morning.
delivery.example_translation: 供应商今天上午确认了送货日期。
delivery.usage: delivery time / date，指货物预计送达的时间或日期。

delivery.example: Delivery to remote areas may take an extra day.
delivery.example_translation: 递送到偏远地区可能需要多一天。
delivery.usage: delivery to + 地点，表示把货物递送到某处。

description.example: The report includes a brief description of the accident.
description.example_translation: 报告简要描述了此次事故。
description.usage: a description of + 事物，表示对其特征或经过的描述。

description.example: The brochure gives a detailed description of each tour route.
description.example_translation: 宣传册详细描述了每条游览路线。
description.usage: a detailed description of + 对象，表示对其外观或特征的详细描绘。

destination.example: The shipment reached its destination ahead of schedule.
destination.example_translation: 货物提前到达了目的地。
destination.spelling_prompt: 行程的目的地，即旅客或货物计划最终到达的地点
destination.usage: reach a destination，表示抵达行程的目的地。

detail.example: The supervisor explained the safety procedure in detail.
detail.example_translation: 主管详细解释了安全操作程序。
detail.usage: in detail，表示逐一细谈情况或步骤。

determine.example: The survey results will determine our service hours.
determine.example_translation: 调查结果将决定我们的营业时间。
determine.usage: determine + 名词，表示决定某事，例如 determine the schedule。

develop.example: The team is developing a new system for tracking orders.
develop.example_translation: 团队正在开发一套新的订单跟踪系统。
develop.usage: develop a product / system，表示开发产品或系统。

discount.example: The store discounts older models at the end of the season.
discount.example_translation: 这家店会在季末给老款商品打折。
discount.usage: discount selected products，表示给选定的商品打折。

discount.example: The hotel offers a discount on longer stays.
discount.example_translation: 酒店对住得较久的顾客提供折扣。
discount.usage: offer a discount on something，表示对某件商品或服务提供折扣。

distribute.example: Volunteers distributed information leaflets to visitors.
distribute.example_translation: 志愿者向来访者分发了信息传单。
distribute.usage: distribute something to + 接收者，表示把物品分发给对方。

district.example: Our new office is in the central business district.
district.example_translation: 我们的新办公室位于中央商务区。
district.usage: a business / shopping district，表示城市中商业或购物集中的区域。

effective.example: Regular training is an effective way to reduce errors.
effective.example_translation: 定期培训是减少错误的有效方式。
effective.usage: an effective way to do something，表示能达到预期效果的做法。

employee.example: Each full-time employee may apply for a parking permit.
employee.example_translation: 每位全职员工都可以申请停车许可。
employee.spelling_prompt: 雇员，指受雇于公司并由该公司支付薪酬的人
employee.usage: full-time employee，指与单位有雇佣关系的全职员工。

employee.example: All new employees attend a training session on their first day.
employee.example_translation: 所有新员工在入职第一天都要参加培训。
employee.usage: new employee orientation，表示为新员工举办的入职介绍会。

employment.example: The program helps recent graduates find employment.
employment.example_translation: 该项目帮助应届毕业生找到工作。
employment.usage: find employment，表示找到工作，此义通常不可数。

ensure.example: Please ensure that all files are backed up.
ensure.example_translation: 请确保所有文件都已备份。
ensure.usage: ensure that + 从句，表示确认或采取措施确保某事。

equipment.example: The company replaced its old office equipment.
equipment.example_translation: 公司更换了老旧的办公设备。
equipment.usage: office equipment，指办公设备。通常作不可数名词。

essential.example: Clear instructions are essential for a safe installation.
essential.example_translation: 清楚的说明对安全安装必不可少。
essential.usage: be essential for something，表示对某件事必不可少。

essential.example: Regular maintenance is an essential part of building management.
essential.example_translation: 定期维护是楼宇管理不可缺少的一部分。
essential.usage: an essential part of something，指不可缺少的一部分。

executive.example: A senior executive will speak at the annual meeting.
executive.example_translation: 一名高级管理人员将在年会上发言。
executive.usage: a senior executive 指在组织中担任高级管理职务的人。

existing.example: The discount also applies to existing customers.
existing.example_translation: 这个折扣也适用于现有客户。
existing.usage: existing + 顾客、合同或设备，指已经存在或在使用的对象。

expand.example: Could you expand on the last point in your report?
expand.example_translation: 你能详细说明报告中的最后一点吗？
expand.usage: expand on a point，表示详细说明某一点。

expand.example: The company hopes to expand into new markets next year.
expand.example_translation: 这家公司希望明年拓展新市场。
expand.usage: expand into new markets，表示扩展到新市场。

experience.example: Jon has experience in managing overseas accounts.
experience.example_translation: 乔恩有管理海外客户账户的经验。
experience.usage: have experience in + 领域，表示在该领域有经验，此义通常不可数。

experience.example: Customers can experience the new service before signing up.
experience.example_translation: 顾客可以在注册前体验这项新服务。
experience.usage: experience a service firsthand，表示亲自体验某项服务。

experience.example: Employees may experience stress during a system change.
experience.example_translation: 系统变更期间，员工可能会感到压力。
experience.usage: experience stress or discomfort，表示感到压力或不适。

experienced.example: An experienced technician inspected the equipment.
experienced.example_translation: 一位经验丰富的技术人员检查了设备。
experienced.usage: an experienced + 人员，表示某人在其职业方面经验丰富。

extend.example: The director agreed to extend the deadline by a week.
extend.example_translation: 主管同意把截止期限延长一周。
extend.usage: extend a deadline，表示延长截止期限。

extend.example: The association extended an invitation to local business owners.
extend.example_translation: 协会向当地企业主发出了邀请。
extend.usage: extend an invitation to someone，表示向某人发出邀请。

extend.example: The bus route now extends to the train station.
extend.example_translation: 公交线路现已延伸到火车站。
extend.usage: extend to a location，表示延伸到某处。

extend.example: The company extended its delivery service to three more towns.
extend.example_translation: 公司把配送服务扩展到了另外三个城镇。
extend.usage: extend a service to more locations，表示扩大服务覆盖范围。

extremely.example: The first week after the launch was extremely busy.
extremely.example_translation: 上线后的第一周极其忙碌。

face.example: Passengers may face delays during the maintenance work.
face.example_translation: 检修期间，乘客可能会遇到延误。
face.usage: face a delay / problem，直接接面临的问题，无需介词。

facility.example: The company opened a training facility outside the city.
facility.example_translation: 公司在城外开设了一处培训场所。
facility.usage: a training / testing facility，表示用于特定目的的场所或设施。

facility.example: The new training facility can seat one hundred people.
facility.example_translation: 新培训场所可容纳一百人。
facility.usage: a training facility，指用于培训的场所或设施。

facility.example: The campus has modern research facilities.
facility.example_translation: 校园配备了现代化的研究设施。
facility.usage: research facilities，指供研究工作使用的设施或设备。

favorable.example: The new freight rates created favorable conditions for expansion.
favorable.example_translation: 新的运价为业务扩张创造了有利条件。
favorable.usage: favorable conditions for + 事项，表示有利于该事项的条件。

feature.example: The magazine published a feature on local manufacturers.
feature.example_translation: 杂志刊登了一篇关于本地制造商的专题报道。
feature.usage: a feature on something，指关于某主题的深度报道。

feature.example: I read a feature article about the city's new library.
feature.example_translation: 我读了一篇介绍该市新图书馆的特写文章。
feature.usage: a feature article，指专门刊登的一篇报道。

feature.example: The exhibition features photographs by local artists.
feature.example_translation: 展览以本地艺术家的摄影作品为特色。
feature.usage: feature something，表示把某事物作为亮点展示。

feature.example: A key feature of the new phone is its long battery life.
feature.example_translation: 这部新手机的一大特点是电池续航长。
feature.usage: a key feature，指一项突出的特点。

feature.example: The rooftop garden is one of the hotel's main features.
feature.example_translation: 屋顶花园是这家酒店的主要特色之一。
feature.usage: one of the main features，指主要特色之一。

field.example: She has worked in the field of urban planning for ten years.
field.example_translation: 她在城市规划领域工作了十年。
field.usage: in the field of + 专业，表示在某个专业领域。

financial.example: The committee reviewed the quarterly financial report.
financial.example_translation: 委员会审阅了季度财务报告。
financial.usage: financial report 指反映某机构财务状况的报告。

financial.example: The rules apply to all local financial institutions.
financial.example_translation: 这些规定适用于当地所有金融机构。
financial.usage: financial institution 指提供银行、信贷等服务的金融机构。

forward.example: Please forward the revised agenda to the sales team.
forward.example_translation: 请将修订后的议程转发给销售团队。
forward.usage: forward a message to someone，表示把已经收到的消息转发给某人。

goods.example: The carrier delivers goods to our regional offices every Monday.
goods.example_translation: 承运商每周一向我们的地区办事处运送货物。
goods.usage: deliver goods，表示运送商品或货物。

guarantee.example: We cannot guarantee delivery by Friday.
guarantee.example_translation: 我们无法保证在星期五前送达。
guarantee.usage: guarantee delivery by + 日期，表示保证在指定日期前送达。

guideline.example: Please follow the guidelines for processing returns.
guideline.usage: follow the guidelines for something，表示遵循某项工作的指南。

guideline.example: The safety guidelines apply to everyone in the lab.
guideline.example_translation: 这些安全准则适用于实验室里的所有人。
guideline.usage: safety guidelines，指应当遵循的安全准则。

handle.example: Our support team handles refund requests within two business days.
handle.example_translation: 我们的客服团队在两个工作日内处理退款请求。
handle.usage: handle a complaint / request，表示处理投诉或请求。

handpick.example: The director handpicked three designers for the project.
handpick.example_translation: 主管亲自为该项目选了三位设计师。
handpick.spelling_prompt: 亲自精挑细选（例如由主管亲自选定项目成员）
handpick.usage: handpick someone for a role，指亲自挑选某人担任一个角色。

head.example: Ms. Chen will head the new sales team.
head.example_translation: 陈女士将带领新销售团队。
head.usage: head a team / department，表示领导一个团队或部门。

hesitate.example: She hesitated to raise the issue during the meeting.
hesitate.example_translation: 她犹豫是否要在会上提出这个问题。
hesitate.usage: hesitate to do something 表示犹豫是否做某事。

imply.example: His reply implied that the schedule might change.
imply.example_translation: 他的回复暗示日程可能会调整。
imply.usage: imply that + 从句，表示话里暗含某个意思。

improvement.example: We saw an improvement in delivery times after adding a second team.
improvement.example_translation: 增加第二支团队后，配送时间有所缩短。
improvement.usage: an improvement in + 指标，表示某一指标有所改善。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and parking.
include.example_translation: 这个价格包含早餐及停车费。
include.usage: include something in a price，表示价格包含某项费用。

inconvenience.example: The entrance closure may cause inconvenience to visitors.
inconvenience.example_translation: 入口关闭可能给来访者带来不便。
inconvenience.usage: cause inconvenience to + 人，表示给某人带来不便。

indicate.example: The latest figures indicate that demand may be slowing.
indicate.example_translation: 最新数据显示需求增速可能正在放缓。
indicate.usage: indicate that + 从句，表示某个迹象暗示了什么。

indicate.example: Please indicate your preferred delivery date on the form.
indicate.example_translation: 请在表格上注明您希望安排的送货日期。
indicate.usage: indicate a preference，表示说明自己的偏好。

indicate.example: The report indicates that sales increased last month.
indicate.example_translation: 报告显示上个月销售额有所增长。
indicate.usage: indicate that + 从句，表示用数据或迹象表明情况。

inform.example: An employee informed on the manager who had falsified the accounts.
inform.example_translation: 一名员工告发了伪造账目的经理。
inform.usage: inform on someone，表示向当局告发某人。

inform.example: We will inform all staff of the change by email.
inform.example_translation: 我们会通过电子邮件通知全体员工这项变动。
inform.usage: inform someone of a change，表示把变动通知某人。

inform.example: The receptionist informed me that the meeting had moved.
inform.example_translation: 接待员告诉我会议已改地点。
inform.usage: inform someone that + 从句，表示将情况告知某人。

inquire.example: Please call the hotel to inquire about room availability.
inquire.example_translation: 请致电酒店询问是否还有空房。
inquire.usage: inquire about availability，表示询问是否有空位或货源。

inquire.example: She called to inquire about the training program.
inquire.example_translation: 她打电话询问培训项目的情况。
inquire.usage: inquire about something，表示打听或查询信息。

inquiry.example: We received an inquiry about the group discount.
inquiry.example_translation: 我们收到了一条关于团体折扣的咨询。
inquiry.usage: an inquiry about + 事项，表示就某事项进行咨询。

install.example: A technician will install the new badge reader tomorrow.
install.example_translation: 技术人员明天将安装新的工牌读取器。
install.usage: install software / equipment，表示安装软件或设备。

investment.example: The company increased its investment in warehouse automation.
investment.example_translation: 公司增加了对仓库自动化的投资。
investment.usage: investment in + 技术或资产，表示将资金投入某个领域。

invitation.example: We accepted an invitation to the opening ceremony.
invitation.example_translation: 我们接受了出席开幕式的邀请。
invitation.usage: accept an invitation to + 活动，表示接受参加活动的邀请。

invoice.example: The supplier will issue an invoice when the goods are shipped.
invoice.example_translation: 供应商会在货物发出时开具发票。
invoice.usage: issue / send an invoice，表示开具或发送发票。

involve.example: We want to involve more staff in the project.
involve.example_translation: 我们希望让更多员工参与这个项目。
involve.usage: involve someone in a project，表示让某人参与项目。

involve.example: The job involves traveling to client sites.
involve.example_translation: 这项工作需要到客户现场出差。
involve.usage: involve doing something，表示某项工作包括做某事。

involve.example: Updating the website involves three teams.
involve.example_translation: 更新网站涉及三个团队。
involve.usage: involve several teams，表示涉及多个团队。

involve.example_translation: 这项调查牵涉多个部门。
involve.usage: involve several departments，表示牵涉多个部门。

issue.example: The article appeared in the latest issue of the magazine.
issue.example_translation: 这篇文章刊登在该杂志最新一期上。
issue.usage: the latest issue of a magazine，指杂志的最新一期。

issue.example: The technician resolved the issue before noon.
issue.example_translation: 技术人员在中午前解决了这个问题。
issue.usage: resolve an issue，表示解决问题。

issue.example: The city issued an announcement about the road closure.
issue.example_translation: 市政府发布了有关道路封闭的公告。
issue.usage: issue an announcement，表示正式发布公告。

issue.example: The cashier issued a receipt for the purchase.
issue.example_translation: 收银员为这笔购物开具了收据。
issue.usage: issue a receipt，表示开具收据。

maintain.example: A contractor maintains the elevators every month.
maintain.example_translation: 承包商每月对电梯进行保养。
maintain.usage: maintain equipment，指进行定期保养以保持设备可用。

maintain.example: The hotel maintains a high standard of service during the peak season.
maintain.example_translation: 酒店在旺季也保持着高标准的服务。
maintain.usage: maintain + 标准、联系或状态，表示使其持续。

majority.example: The majority of respondents preferred morning sessions.
majority.example_translation: 大多数受访者更喜欢上午的场次。
majority.usage: the majority of + 复数名词，表示其中的大多数。

management.example: Senior management approved the plan to renovate the lobby.
management.example_translation: 高层管理人员批准了翻修大厅的计划。
management.usage: senior management，指企业中负责重要决策的高层管理人员。

management.example: He oversees the management of the company’s rental properties.
management.example_translation: 他负责管理公司的出租物业。
management.usage: the management of + 业务或资源，指组织和管理这项业务或资源。

morale.example: The manager thanked the crew to boost morale after a difficult week.
morale.example_translation: 艰难的一周过后，经理向团队致谢以鼓舞士气。
morale.spelling_prompt: 士气，尤指员工或团队整体的精神状态
morale.usage: boost staff morale，表示提高员工士气，此义不可数。

negotiation.example: We entered into negotiations with a new freight provider.
negotiation.example_translation: 我们开始与一家新的货运服务商谈判。
negotiation.usage: enter into negotiations with + 对方，表示与某方开始商谈。

nonrefundable.example: Please note that the registration fee is nonrefundable.
nonrefundable.example_translation: 请注意，报名费不可退还。
nonrefundable.spelling_prompt: 不能退款的，指费用或款项按规定不予退回
nonrefundable.usage: a nonrefundable deposit / fare，表示付款后无法退款。

notify.example: We will notify all applicants of the result by email.
notify.example_translation: 我们将通过电子邮件通知所有申请者结果。
notify.usage: notify someone of + 事项，表示正式通知某人。

observe.example: The trainer observed how employees handled customer complaints.
observe.example_translation: 培训师观察了员工处理客户投诉的方式。
observe.usage: observe + 对象，表示认真观察该对象或情况。

obtain.example: Visitors must obtain permission before entering the laboratory.
obtain.example_translation: 访客进入实验室之前必须取得许可。
obtain.usage: obtain permission from + 人或机构，表示取得许可。

offer.example: The hotel offers guests a free airport shuttle.
offer.example_translation: 酒店为宾客提供免费机场接驳车。
offer.usage: offer someone something，给某人提供某物。

on-going.example: The office will remain open during the ongoing renovations.
on-going.example_translation: 翻修期间，办公室将继续开放。
on-going.usage: an ongoing investigation，表示调查仍在进行。

opportunity.example: The internship offers an opportunity to learn about marketing.
opportunity.example_translation: 这次实习提供了了解市场营销的机会。
opportunity.usage: an opportunity to do something，指做某事的机会。

outcome.example: We will announce the outcome of the vote on Friday.
outcome.example_translation: 我们将在周五公布投票结果。
outcome.usage: the outcome of + 活动或过程，表示该活动或过程的最终结果。

outstanding.example: Please pay the outstanding balance by the end of the month.
outstanding.example_translation: 请在月底前付清尚未结清的余额。
outstanding.usage: an outstanding balance，指应付而尚未结清的余额。

outstanding.example: Maya received an award for outstanding customer service.
outstanding.example_translation: 玛雅因出色的客户服务而获奖。
outstanding.usage: outstanding service / performance，表示表现远超通常标准。

participant.example: Each participant in the trial completed a feedback form.
participant.example_translation: 试点项目的每位参与者都填写了反馈表。
participant.spelling_prompt: 参加者，指实际参加试验或项目并完成其中任务的人
participant.usage: participant in + 活动，指实际参与某项任务或活动的人。

payment.example: You can make a payment through the customer portal.
payment.example_translation: 您可以通过客户门户付款。
payment.usage: make a payment 表示付一笔款，可用于租金、账单或分期款。

perform.example: The orchestra will perform at the theater on Saturday.
perform.example_translation: 管弦乐团将于星期六在剧院演出。
perform.usage: perform at a venue，表示在某处登台演出。

perform.example: She performed well under pressure during the presentation.
perform.example_translation: 她在演示过程中顶住压力，表现出色。
perform.usage: perform well under pressure，表示在压力下表现出色。

perform.example: A technician will perform an inspection of the equipment.
perform.example_translation: 技术人员将对设备进行检查。
perform.usage: perform an inspection，表示进行检查。

performance.example: Managers review employee performance twice a year.
performance.example_translation: 经理每年评估两次员工的工作表现。
performance.usage: review employee performance，表示评估员工的工作表现。

performance.example: The theater added a second performance on Saturday.
performance.example_translation: 剧院在周六增加了第二场演出。
performance.usage: a live performance，表示在观众面前现场表演。

position.example: He applied for a position in customer service.
position.example_translation: 他申请了一个客服岗位。
position.usage: apply for a position，表示申请一个职位。

position.example: The firm is advertising a full-time position in accounting.
position.example_translation: 这家公司正在招聘一名全职会计。

position.example: Position the package near the front door for pickup.
position.example_translation: 把包裹放在前门附近，方便取件。
position.usage: position something near something，表示把某物放在某处附近。

position.example: Please mark the position of the door on the drawing.
position.example_translation: 请在图纸上标出门的位置。
position.usage: the position of an object，指物体所处的位置。

positive.example: The new training program received positive feedback from staff.
positive.example_translation: 新的培训项目得到了员工的积极评价。
positive.usage: positive feedback 指肯定或赞扬某事的反馈。

potential.example: The new system has the potential to reduce delivery delays.
potential.example_translation: 新系统有潜力减少送货延误。
potential.usage: have the potential to do something，表示有做某事的潜力。

potential.example: The company contacted several potential customers.
potential.example_translation: 公司联系了几位潜在客户。

precisely.example: The live broadcast began precisely at noon.
precisely.spelling_prompt: 精确地，或强调恰好在某个确切时间
precisely.usage: precisely at + 时间，强调恰在某个时刻。

predict.example: Analysts predict that demand will rise next month.
predict.example_translation: 分析师预计下个月需求会上升。
predict.usage: predict that + 从句，表示预计某种情况将发生。

presentation.example: Nora will give a presentation on the updated returns policy.
presentation.example_translation: 诺拉将介绍更新后的退货政策。
presentation.usage: give a presentation on + 主题，表示就该主题作介绍。

procedure.example: Staff must follow the same procedure when issuing refunds.
procedure.example_translation: 员工办理退款时必须遵循同一流程。
procedure.spelling_prompt: 办理某事项时须按顺序执行的一套规定步骤
procedure.usage: follow a procedure，表示按规定步骤办理。

process.example: The factory processes raw materials on site.
process.example_translation: 这家工厂在现场加工原材料。
process.usage: process raw materials，表示加工原材料。

process.example: It takes three days to process an application.
process.example_translation: 处理一份申请需要三天。
process.usage: process an application，表示处理申请。

process.example: The hiring process includes two interviews.
process.example_translation: 招聘流程包括两轮面试。

process.example: The new production process uses less energy.
process.example_translation: 新的生产工序消耗的能源更少。
process.usage: a production process，指生产过程或工序。

professional.example: A trained professional should inspect the wiring.
professional.example_translation: 应由受过培训的专业人员检查电线线路。
professional.usage: a trained professional 指受过相关培训的专业人员。

professional.example: We sought professional advice before signing the lease.
professional.example_translation: 我们在签署租约前征求了专业意见。
professional.usage: professional advice 指有资质或经验的人给出的专业意见。

property.example: The firm manages commercial property near the station.
property.example_translation: 该公司在车站附近管理商业房地产。
property.usage: commercial property，指用于经营的房屋或房地产。

provide.example: The hotel provides guests with free internet access.
provide.example_translation: 酒店为住客提供免费上网服务。
provide.usage: provide someone with something，表示向某人提供某物。

purchase.example: You can return the purchase to any of our stores.
purchase.example_translation: 你可以到我们的任何一家门店退回所购商品。
purchase.usage: return a purchase，表示退回所购商品。

purchase.example: Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
purchase.example_translation: 请保留购物收据作为购买凭证。

purchase.example: We plan to purchase new equipment in March.
purchase.example_translation: 我们计划在三月份购买新设备。
purchase.usage: purchase equipment from a supplier，表示从供应商购买设备。

purpose.example: The purpose of the meeting is to review the results.
purpose.example_translation: 开会的目的是审查这些结果。
purpose.usage: the purpose of + 活动，表示进行该活动的目的。

qualification.example: Professional certification is one of the qualifications for the role.
qualification.example_translation: 专业认证是这个岗位所需的资格之一。
qualification.usage: qualifications for + 职位，指应聘该职位所需的资格。

qualified.example: Both applicants are qualified for the position.
qualified.example_translation: 两位申请人都具备担任该职位的资格。
qualified.usage: be qualified for a position，表示具备担任该职位的资格。

rate.example: The bank lowered the interest rate on new loans.
rate.example_translation: 银行下调了新增贷款的利率。
rate.usage: the interest rate on a loan，指贷款的利率。

rate.example: The contractor charges an hourly rate for repairs.
rate.example_translation: 承包商按小时收取维修费。
rate.usage: an hourly rate，表示每小时的收费标准。

rate.example: Conference guests can book rooms at a discounted rate.
rate.example_translation: 参会人员可以按优惠价预订客房。

rate.example: Customers can rate the service after checkout.
rate.example_translation: 顾客结账后可以评价服务。
rate.usage: rate a service，表示给服务打分或评价。

rate.example: The completion rate improved after the training was shortened.
rate.example_translation: 培训时间缩短后，完成率有所提高。
rate.usage: the completion rate，指完成事项占总数的比例。

recommend.example: I recommend the afternoon workshop to new supervisors.
recommend.example_translation: 我向新任主管推荐下午的研讨班。
recommend.usage: recommend something to someone，表示向某人推荐某物。

recommend.example: We recommend booking early to secure a seat.
recommend.example_translation: 我们建议尽早预订以确保有座位。
recommend.usage: recommend doing something，表示建议采取某项行动。

recruit.example: Each new recruit receives a week of training.
recruit.example_translation: 每名新成员都接受为期一周的培训。
recruit.usage: train a new recruit，表示培训新成员。

recruit.example: The hospital is recruiting additional staff.
recruit.example_translation: 这家医院正在增聘员工。
recruit.usage: recruit staff for a department，表示为部门招聘员工。

recruit.example: We are recruiting an assistant for the finance department.
recruit.example_translation: 我们正在为财务部门招聘一名助理。
recruit.usage: recruit someone for a role，表示为某个岗位招人。

reduce.example: The new routing system reduced delivery delays.
reduce.example_translation: 新的路线规划系统减少了送货延误。
reduce.usage: reduce costs / delays，表示使成本、延误等减少。

reduction.example: The new contract led to a reduction in shipping costs.
reduction.example_translation: 新合同降低了运输成本。
reduction.usage: a reduction in shipping costs 表示运输成本降低。

regarding.example: I am writing regarding your recent invoice.
regarding.example_translation: 我写信是想谈谈您最近收到的那张发票。
regarding.usage: regarding + 名词，用于正式邮件中引出主题。

regarding.example: I am writing regarding your question about the contract.
regarding.example_translation: 我写信是为了回复您关于合同的问题。
regarding.usage: regarding + 名词，表示关于或涉及该事项。

registration.example: Registration for the training session closes on Monday.
registration.example_translation: 这场培训的报名将于周一截止。
registration.usage: registration for + 活动，表示为参加该活动而登记。

release.example: The singer will discuss her latest release on the radio.
release.example_translation: 这位歌手将在电台谈论她最近发行的新作品。
release.usage: the latest release，指最近发行的新作。

release.example: The committee will release the results on Friday.
release.example_translation: 委员会将在星期五公布结果。
release.usage: release the results，表示正式公布结果。

release.example: The company plans to release a new camera next month.
release.example_translation: 这家公司计划下个月推出一款新相机。
release.usage: release a new product，表示推出新产品。

release.example: The company will not release any personal information to the public.
release.example_translation: 公司不会向公众公开任何个人信息。
release.usage: release information to the public，表示向公众公开信息。

remarkable.example: The new workflow led to a remarkable improvement in accuracy.
remarkable.example_translation: 新的工作流程显著提高了准确率。
remarkable.usage: a remarkable improvement，表示幅度足以引人注意的改善。

remind.example: The receptionist reminded visitors to sign out before leaving.
remind.example_translation: 接待员提醒来访者离开前签字登记。
remind.usage: remind someone to do something，表示提醒某人做某事。

replacement.example: The board will appoint a replacement for the retiring director.
replacement.example_translation: 董事会将任命一人接替即将退休的总监。
replacement.usage: a replacement for + 人，指接任某人工作的人。

replacement.example: The budget covers the replacement of two delivery vans.
replacement.example_translation: 预算涵盖了更换两辆送货货车的费用。
replacement.usage: replacement of + 旧物，表示把已有物品换成新的。

replacement.example: The technician ordered a replacement part for the printer.
replacement.example_translation: 技术人员为打印机订购了一个替换零件。
replacement.usage: a replacement part，指用于替换已损坏或磨损的零件。

request.example: The supervisor approved my request for leave.
request.example_translation: 主管批准了我的请假申请。
request.usage: a request for leave，指请假申请。

request.example: Customers can request a refund within thirty days.
request.example_translation: 顾客可以在三十天内申请退款。
request.usage: request a refund，表示正式提出退款要求。

require.example: The new rule requires drivers to check the vehicle before each trip.
require.example_translation: 新规定要求司机每次出车前都检查车辆。
require.usage: require someone to do something，表示依规定要求某人做某事。

requirement.example: A current license is a requirement for this role.
requirement.example_translation: 这个岗位要求持有仍然有效的执照。
requirement.spelling_prompt: 必须满足的要求，例如任职资格规定的一项条件
requirement.usage: meet a requirement，表示满足工作、报名等方面的要求。

reservation.example: I made a reservation for two nights at the hotel.
reservation.example_translation: 我在那家酒店预订了两晚住宿。
reservation.usage: make a reservation for + 人数、日期或服务，表示事先预订。

reserve.example: Could you reserve a meeting room for Thursday afternoon?
reserve.example_translation: 您能预订一间周四下午用的会议室吗？
reserve.usage: reserve a room / seat，表示事先订好房间或座位。

resident.example: Local residents can use the new park free of charge.
resident.example_translation: 当地居民可以免费使用这座新公园。
resident.usage: local residents 指住在当地的人。

respond.example: Please respond to the invitation by noon on Tuesday.
respond.example_translation: 请在周二中午前回复邀请。
respond.usage: respond to + 消息或请求，表示回应。

result in.example: The software update resulted in fewer processing errors.
result in.example_translation: 软件更新后，处理错误减少了。
result in.usage: result in + 结果，表示前面的事件导致后面的结果。

retail.example: Working in retail taught him to deal with customer complaints.
retail.example_translation: 零售业的工作经历让他学会了处理客户投诉。
retail.usage: work in retail，表示在零售行业工作。

retirement.example: After retirement, Ms. Rao plans to mentor small business owners.
retirement.example_translation: 饶女士退休后计划指导小企业业主。
retirement.spelling_prompt: 退休，指结束职业生涯的状态或时点
retirement.usage: after retirement，表示退休后的时间。

review.example: Could you review the draft contract before Tuesday?
review.example_translation: 您能在星期二前审阅合同草案吗？
review.usage: review a draft / document，表示审阅草稿或文件。

review.example: The committee will review all applications next week.
review.example_translation: 委员会将在下周审查所有申请。
review.usage: review an application，表示审查申请的内容。

schedule.example: Please check the training schedule before booking your trip.
schedule.example_translation: 请在预订行程前查看培训时间表。
schedule.usage: check the schedule，表示查看时间表。

schedule.example: The manager has a busy schedule this week.
schedule.example_translation: 经理这周的日程排得很满。
schedule.usage: a busy schedule，指排得很满的日程。

schedule.example: We scheduled the interview for Tuesday morning.
schedule.example_translation: 我们把面试安排在星期二上午。
schedule.usage: schedule a meeting for a time，表示把会议安排在某个时间。

significant.example: The figures show a significant decrease in delivery times.
significant.example_translation: 数据表明配送时间明显缩短了。
significant.usage: a significant increase / decrease 表示幅度显著的增长或下降。

significant.example: Transport costs are a significant factor in our decision.
significant.example_translation: 运输成本是我们作决定时考虑的重要因素。
significant.usage: a significant factor 指会对结果产生重要影响的因素。

specialist.example: We consulted a specialist in workplace safety.
specialist.example_translation: 我们咨询了一位工作场所安全专家。
specialist.usage: a specialist in + 领域，指专门从事该领域工作的人。

step down.example: Mr. Wong will step down as chair at the end of the year.
step down.example_translation: 王先生将在年底辞去主席职务。
step down.usage: step down as + 职位，表示辞去该职位。

stock.example: The store stocks replacement batteries for older models.
stock.example_translation: 该店备有旧型号设备使用的替换电池。
stock.usage: stock a product，表示囤有某种商品以备出售或使用。

strict.example: The laboratory is strict about wearing safety glasses.
strict.example_translation: 实验室严格要求佩戴护目镜。
strict.usage: be strict about + 事项，表示对该事项要求严格。

submit.example: Please submit the expense report by Friday.
submit.example_translation: 请在周五前提交费用报销单。
submit.usage: submit an application / report，表示按要求提交材料。

submit.example: Please submit your expense report to the finance team.
submit.example_translation: 请将费用报告递交给财务团队。
submit.usage: submit a report to + 收件方，表示向其递交报告。

successful.example: After a successful launch, the team expanded the service to three cities.
successful.example_translation: 服务成功推出后，团队将它扩展到了三个城市。
successful.usage: a successful launch，表示取得预期成效的发布。

superior.example: Please report the issue to your immediate superior.
superior.example_translation: 请向你的直属上司报告这个问题。
superior.usage: an immediate superior 指直属上司。

superior.example: The new model is superior to the old one in reliability.
superior.example_translation: 这款新型号在可靠性上优于旧型号。
superior.usage: be superior to + 比较对象，表示质量或性能优于对方。

supply.example: We ordered more office supplies online.
supply.example_translation: 我们在网上增订了一些办公用品。
supply.usage: office supplies 指办公用品，如纸和笔，常用复数形式。

supply.example: The vendor supplies our offices with drinking water.
supply.example_translation: 这家供应商为我们的办公室供应饮用水。
supply.usage: supply someone with something，表示向某人供应某物。

support.example: Most committee members supported the proposal.
support.example_translation: 大多数委员支持这项提案。
support.usage: support a proposal / project，表示赞成提案或支持项目。

take place.example: The orientation will take place in Conference Room B.
take place.example_translation: 入职介绍会将在 B 会议室举行。
take place.usage: take place + 时间或地点，常用于说明活动何时何地举行。

the course of action.example: After reviewing the figures, we decided on a course of action.
the course of action.example_translation: 审阅数据后，我们确定了下一步行动方案。
the course of action.usage: decide on a course of action，表示确定接下来采取的一套行动。

transfer.example: I transferred the payment to the supplier's account.
transfer.example_translation: 我已把款项转入供应商的账户。
transfer.usage: transfer money to an account，表示把钱转到某个账户。

transfer.example: The firm transferred ownership of the building last year.
transfer.example_translation: 这家公司去年移交了大楼的所有权。
transfer.usage: transfer ownership of something，表示移交所有权。

transfer.example: The company transferred her to its regional office.
transfer.example_translation: 公司把她调到了地区办事处。
transfer.usage: transfer someone to another office，表示把某人调到另一办公室。

volunteer.example: A volunteer at the job fair directed visitors to the interview rooms.
volunteer.example_translation: 招聘会上的一名志愿者引导来访者前往面试室。
volunteer.spelling_prompt: 志愿者，指自愿且通常不领取报酬、为公益或活动提供服务的人
volunteer.usage: a volunteer at + 场所或活动，指在该处服务的志愿者。

volunteer.example: Two employees volunteered to help at the charity event.
volunteer.example_translation: 两名员工自愿在慈善活动上帮忙。
volunteer.usage: volunteer to do something，表示主动提出承担某项任务。

warehouse.example: We store spare parts in a warehouse near the port.
warehouse.example_translation: 我们把备件存放在港口附近的一座仓库里。
warehouse.spelling_prompt: 仓库，专门存放货物的大型设施
warehouse.usage: store goods in a warehouse，表示把货物存放在仓库内。

working conditions.example: The agreement will improve working conditions at the factory.
working conditions.example_translation: 该协议将改善工厂员工的工作条件。
working conditions.usage: improve working conditions，表示改善员工的工作环境和待遇。

workplace.example: All staff must attend the workplace safety training.
workplace.example_translation: 所有员工都必须参加工作场所安全培训。
